description_en: Retrieves the component installation records of a cluster
description_zh: 获取集群组件安装记录
name: ListClusterAgentInstallRecords

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Filters by cluster ID.

This cluster ID is not the ACK cluster ID. It is the `cluster_id` field in the data returned by this operation, or the `id` field in the data returned by the ListCluster operation
parameters.help_zh:
通过集群 ID 过滤

这个集群ID不是 ACK 集群ID，而是通过本接口返回的数据里面的 `cluster_id` 字段，或者 ListCluster 接口返回数据中的 `id` 字段
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies the agent ID to filter the installation list for the specified agent. This parameter can be used together with the plugin_version parameter
parameters.help_zh: 指定本参数则过滤出指定Agent的安装列表，可以搭配 plugin_version 参数使用
parameters.name: plugin_id

parameters.help_en: Cannot be used alone. Use this parameter together with plugin_id to filter the installation list for a specified version of the specified agent
parameters.help_zh: 不可单独使用，搭配 plugin_id 使用，用于过滤出指定Agent指定版本的安装列表
parameters.name: plugin_version
